scope: Couple behavioral current fault detector and sticky latch to EN sink in existing power model
limitations: Behavioral detector and ideal 10 ohm EN sink, not selected parts
Latch persistence with auxiliary power absent is ideal state retention, not a physical circuit guarantee
EN disable is not galvanic isolation or proof of motor torque removal
Nominal timing/noise and limited static sensor corner
External scheduled battery disconnect still at80ms; no restart/recovery test
